annotations.text:
Direction A: Paper (recommended)

What changes from polyvise.ai today:
1. Light, warm default with dark as a peer. The current dark-only console reads as a developer tool before anyone has typed a question.
2. The question box IS the home page. No overview hero to scroll past.
3. Mode names a newcomer can parse (Debate, Consensus, Advisory panel) with a five-dot diagram of who is in the room, instead of Hybrid Council + ADVERSARIAL / 5 AGENTS chips.
4. Mono uppercase eyebrows retired. Mono stays only for model ids, costs, source refs.
5. Radii 4/8 become 12/18/22 and pills; controls grow to 40/48.
6. Kept: Instrument Serif, the for / against / judge trio, equal-width pro and con columns, failed steps reported not filled in.

Verdict screen

The verdict becomes the run's front page (today it is the second tab). Confidence is a ring, the balance bar and five scored dimensions sit inside the same card, and the agents rail says who was in the room in plain words with the model id underneath.
Two low-fi alternates, sketched so you can compare directions, not polish. Pick A, B or C (or a blend) and the rest of the canvas gets built to match.
